1.1: What was from the very beginning—the Word of Life—we heard it, saw it with our own eyes, looked straight at it, even touched it with our hands.
1.2: That life showed up for real, and we saw it. So now we tell y'all what we know—this eternal life was with the Father and then showed up right here for us to witness.
1.3: What we saw and heard, we tellin' y'all now, so y'all can be part of this too. 'Cause this ain't just us—our connection is with the Father and His Son, Jesus Christ.
1.4: We writin' this so y'all joy can be full—overflowin', not halfway.
1.5: Here's what Jesus told us, and we passin' it to you: God is light. Ain't no darkness in Him, not a drop.
1.6: So if we say, "Yeah, I'm cool with God," but we still out here walkin' in darkness—we lyin'. Ain't no truth in that lifestyle.
1.7: But if we walk in the light, like He in the light? Then we got real community with each other. And the blood of Jesus, His Son, cleans us up from all sin. No stain left behind.
1.8: If we out here actin' like we don't sin, we only foolin' ourselves. The truth ain't even in us.
1.9: But if we keep it real and confess our sins? He faithful and just—He gon' forgive us and wipe away all the mess. Every bit of unrighteousness.
1.10: But if we act like we ain't never sinned? We callin' God a liar. And trust—His word ain't livin' in us.

2.1: My babies, I'm writin' this so y'all don't fall into sin. But if you do mess up, know this—we got an Advocate up in heaven: Jesus Christ, the righteous one.
2.2: He's the one who paid the full price for our sins—and not just ours, but the whole world's.
2.3: Here's how we really know we know Him: if we keep His commandments.
2.4: If somebody say, "I know God," but don't do what He say? That's a straight-up lie, and the truth ain't in 'em.
2.5: But if you keep His word, God's love is perfected in you. That's how we know we in Him.
2.6: If you say you rock with Jesus, then walk how He walked. Point blank.
2.7: Dear fam, this ain't even a new command I'm givin' you. It's the same Word you heard from the jump.
2.8: But in a way, it is new—'cause it's now real in Him and in you. The darkness is gettin' pushed out. The true light is shinin' now.
2.9: If you claim you in the light but hate your brother? Nah, you still walkin' in the dark.
2.10: But if you love your brother, you livin' in the light—and you ain't causin' nobody to trip.
2.11: But hate? That's darkness. And if you walk in hate, you lost—you don't even know where you goin', 'cause the dark done blinded you.
2.12: I'm writin' to you, little ones, 'cause your sins been forgiven in His name.
2.13: I'm writin' to you, fathers—you know the One who been here since the beginning. I'm writin' to y'all, young men—y'all done beat the enemy. I'm writin' to y'all, little children—y'all know the Father.
2.14: I already wrote to the fathers—y'all seasoned. Y'all know Him. To the young men again—you strong. The Word is in you. Y'all done crushed the wicked one.
2.15: Don't love the world or the stuff in it. If that's where your heart at, the love of the Father ain't.
2.16: 'Cause everything the world chasin'—fleshly cravings, flashy eyes, pride in status—it ain't from God. That's worldly noise.
2.17: And the world? It's fading fast. But whoever does God's will? They last forever.
2.18: Little ones, it's the last hour. You've heard the Antichrist comin'. But guess what? Many antichrists already out here. That's how we know it's go-time.
2.19: They used to roll with us—but they left. And that just showed they never really was with us.
2.20: But you? You anointed by the Holy One. You got spiritual insight.
2.21: I'm not writin' like y'all don't know the truth—you do. And no lie lives in truth.
2.22: Who the real liar? The one who denies that Jesus is the Christ. That's the Antichrist—deny the Son, you deny the Father too.
2.23: If you deny the Son, you don't got the Father. But if you got the Son? The Father's yours too.
2.24: So keep what you heard from the start in you. If it stay in you, you gon' stay in the Son and the Father too.
2.25: And what He promised us? Eternal life. That's the deal.
2.26: I'm writin' this 'cause some folks tryna deceive you.
2.27: But you got the anointing, and it stays in you. You don't need somebody new every time to teach you. That anointing gon' show you what's real, what's true—not fake. So stay rooted in Him.
2.28: So now, little ones, stay in Him. That way when He show up, you can stand bold—not be lookin' crazy or ashamed.
2.29: If you know He's righteous, then you know anyone who walkin' right been born of Him.

3.1: Look at this love the Father poured on us—He really called us His kids! And that's exactly who we are. The world don't recognize us, 'cause they ain't recognize Him.
3.2: Beloved, we already God's children. But what we gon' be? That ain't even fully revealed yet. All we know is this: when Jesus show up, we gon' be like Him—'cause we'll see Him face to face.
3.3: And everybody holdin' on to that hope? They stay purifying themselves—just like He pure.
3.4: Everybody who keep sinnin' is breakin' the law—'cause sin is lawlessness.
3.5: And you already know Jesus showed up to take sin away—and there ain't no sin in Him.
3.6: If you really dwellin' in Him, you don't keep livin' in sin. And if you are? You ain't seen Him or known Him.
3.7: Don't let nobody trick you, little ones. Whoever lives right is righteous—just like Jesus.
3.8: But the one who keep on sinning? That's the devil's child. 'Cause the devil been sinning since jump. That's why the Son of God came—to shut the devil's whole operation down.
3.9: If you been born of God, you don't live in sin. God's seed is in you, and you can't keep wildin'—you been born again.
3.10: Here's how you tell who belongs to God and who don't: if you ain't livin' right or lovin' your brother—you ain't God's. Period.
3.11: The message ain't changed: Love one another. Y'all heard that from the beginning.
3.12: Don't be like Cain—he was on that wicked vibe and killed his brother. And why'd he do it? 'Cause his deeds were evil and his brother's were righteous.
3.13: Don't trip when the world hates you, fam. That's part of the walk.
3.14: We know we crossed over from death to life—'cause we love the fam. If you ain't got that love? You still sittin' in spiritual death.
3.15: If you hate your brother? That's murder in your heart. And no murderer got eternal life in them.
3.16: This how we know what love really is: Jesus laid down His life for us. So we oughta lay down our lives for each other.
3.17: If you got the resources and see your brother in need—but close your heart off? How you claim God's love lives in you?
3.18: My little ones, let's not just talk love—live love. Do it in real action and truth.
3.19: That's how we know we belong to the truth—and how we calm our hearts when they start trippin'.
3.20: Even when your heart condemns you, God is bigger than your heart. He know it all.
3.21: But if your heart's clear? You got confidence before God.
3.22: And whatever we ask, we receive—'cause we keep His commandments and do what pleases Him.
3.23: And this is the command: Believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love each other like He told us to.
3.24: If you keep His commandments, you dwell in Him—and He in you. And how do we know He lives in us? 'Cause His Spirit lives in us.

4.1: Beloved, don't believe every spirit out here—test 'em. Check if they really from God. 'Cause there's a lotta fake prophets runnin' wild in the world.
4.2: Here's how you spot the real Spirit of God: if the spirit confesses that Jesus Christ came in the flesh, that's God's Spirit.
4.3: But any spirit that won't say Jesus came in the flesh? That ain't from God. That's the spirit of the Antichrist—the one y'all heard was comin', and yeah, it's already out here.
4.4: Y'all from God, little ones—and you already beat these false spirits. Why? 'Cause the One in you is greater than the one that's runnin' this world.
4.5: They from the world, so they talk worldly, and the world eats it up.
4.6: But we from God. Whoever knows God gon' hear us. Whoever don't? Won't. That's how we know if a spirit's bringin' truth or bringin' error.
4.7: Beloved, let's love one another. 'Cause love come from God, and everybody who loves is born of God and knows Him.
4.8: But if you don't love? You don't know God. Point blank. 'Cause God is love.
4.9: Here's how He showed love: He sent His one and only Son into the world, so we could live through Him.
4.10: Love ain't about us lovin' God first. Nah—He loved us first, and sent Jesus to take care of our sins.
4.11: So if God loved us like that? We gotta love one another too. No excuses.
4.12: Nobody's seen God face-to-face. But when we love one another? God lives in us. And His love gets fully expressed in us.
4.13: This how we know we're really connected to Him—and He to us: He gave us His Spirit.
4.14: And we seen it. We testifying that the Father sent the Son to save the whole world.
4.15: If you confess Jesus as the Son of God, God lives in you—and you in Him.
4.16: We know the love God got for us, and we believe it. God is love. If you stay rooted in love, you stay rooted in God—and God in you.
4.17: Love matures in us so we can stand bold on judgment day. Why? 'Cause we reppin' Him right here in the world.
4.18: Real love? It don't come with fear. Perfect love kicks fear out, 'cause fear got torment in it. If you still scared, that love ain't fully grown in you yet.
4.19: We love Him—only 'cause He loved us first.
4.20: You sayin', "I love God," but hate your brother? Nah—you lyin'. If you can't love the one right in front of you, how you gon' love the God you ain't even seen?
4.21: And this ain't optional—God already gave us this command: If you love Him, then love your brother too.

5.1: If you believe Jesus is the Christ, you been born of God. And if you love the One who gave birth, you gon' love all His children too.
5.2: This how we know we really love God's people: when we love God and keep His commandments.
5.3: 'Cause loving God ain't just lip service—it means obeying Him. And His commandments? They ain't heavy or hard to carry.
5.4: Anything born of God? Already got the victory over the world. And how we win? Through faith. That's our W.
5.5: So who overcomes the world? The one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God. Period.
5.6: Jesus is the One who came by water and blood—not just water, but both. And the Spirit is the one testifyin', 'cause the Spirit is truth.
5.7: There's three that bear witness in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit—and they one.
5.8: And on earth: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and they all tell the same story.
5.9: If you trust what humans say, trust God more—His witness about His Son hit harder.
5.10: If you believe in the Son, God's truth lives in you. But if you don't? You basically callin' God a liar—'cause you don't believe what He said about Jesus.
5.11: And here's the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and that life is found in His Son.
5.12: If you got the Son, you got life. If not? No life. No cap.
5.13: I'm writin' all this so you who believe in Jesus know you got eternal life—and so you keep believing, even stronger.
5.14: This the confidence we roll with: If we ask anything according to His will, He hearin' us.
5.15: And if we know He hears us? Then we already got what we asked for. That's trust.
5.16: If you see your brother fallin'—but it ain't a sin that leads to death—pray for him. God'll give life. But if it is a sin that leads to death… I ain't sayin' pray on that.
5.17: All unrighteousness is sin, yeah. But not every sin leads to death.
5.18: Whoever been born of God? They don't live in sin. They protect themselves—and the devil can't touch 'em.
5.19: We know we belong to God. But the world? It's caught up in the enemy's grip.
5.20: But we also know this: the Son of God came, gave us understanding, and now we know what's real. We're in Him who's true—Jesus Christ. That's the real God. That's eternal life.
5.21: Little ones, keep yourselves away from idols. Don't let anything fake take God's place.
